testPlan.title: Undo a name a vehicle is heading to

test.title: Step 1: the game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Step 2: make a new name
test.hint: In the editor, name a spot on a road. Then click PASS.

test.title: Step 3: send a vehicle there
test.hint: Use AutoDrive to send a vehicle to that name. Then click PASS.

test.title: Step 4: undo the name
test.passLog: current destination was a marker the undo removed
test.hint: Press undo once. Nothing to click. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Step 5: watch the vehicle
test.hint: The vehicle should drive to the spot and stop there. A message may say Main Farm. Ignore it. Click PASS if it stopped at the spot. Click FAIL if not.
